entries.name: title
entries.label: Title
entries.description: The entry's name (rename it in the tree, or here).

entries.name: comment
entries.label: Comment
entries.description: The note / body of this entry — always available, whatever the type.

entries.name: attachment
entries.label: Image / file
entries.description: For an `image` entry: upload an image (or file); it's stored with the entry and can be downloaded or replaced.

entries.name: type
entries.label: Type
entries.description: group = project folder; task = a piece of work (tasks nest — sub-tasks show in the tasks column); note = a comment in a log (comments nest too — replies); image / wireframe / sheets / docs / sketchpad / bublee = an ATTACHMENT object housed by a task or a comment (its own isolated data; opens full-screen). PLAN objects, shown on the Plan screen rather than in a log: goal = an end state a project is driving at; milestone = a checkpoint on the way to a goal; item = something the goal needs (a `requires` edge points goal → item); decision = a choice, past or pending (see decisionKind).

entries.name: role
entries.label: Role
entries.description: For a work-item (type=task): what it represents. task = work to do; goal = an end state a project drives at; milestone = a checkpoint toward a goal; item = something a goal needs; decision = a choice to make or record (see decisionKind). The Plan screen groups work-items by role.

entries.name: status
entries.label: Status
entries.description: active · queued (backlog) · discussed (talked about, not yet queued — the Priorities tab's Future lane) · done

entries.name: decisionKind
entries.label: Decision kind
entries.description: Only meaningful on a `decision` entry. predetermined = already settled, we know the answer going in. open = a known question still to be answered. emergent = a choice that only surfaced once the work was underway — kept separate from decisions taken earlier, so hindsight never rewrites the record.

entries.name: createdBy
entries.label: Lead
entries.description: Who started / owns this (the lead). Add collaborators in With.

entries.name: prompting
entries.label: Prompting
entries.description: Who this is directed at / asked to respond.

entries.name: with
entries.label: With
entries.description: Collaborators beyond the lead — associate multiple people (e.g. lead You, with Claude) instead of one merged person.

entries.name: bottleneck
entries.label: Bottleneck
entries.description: Mark a project or task that is holding others up. A marker, not a status.

entries.name: blocked
entries.label: Blocked
entries.description: Mark a project or task that can't proceed yet (waiting on something). A marker, orthogonal to status.

entries.name: isLogEntry
entries.label: Log entry
entries.description: projdash-0810: stamped true automatically by the log comment composer on every entry it creates — marks it as log chatter rather than a first-class project item, so the per-project Overview dashboard excludes it from item counts. Not user-editable.

entries.name: awaiting
entries.label: Awaiting reply
entries.description: True while this is an OPEN turn waiting on a response — set automatically when a comment is addressed to someone, cleared when it's marked answered. Shown in the Inbox (open turns), separate from the work status (a task can be active AND awaiting).

entries.name: completedBy
entries.label: Completed by
entries.description: Who actually finished it — set by the completing user, which is not always whoever created it.

entries.name: postedAt
entries.label: Posted
entries.description: The log's precise post instant, stamped once when a comment is added and never touched again (unlike the engine's volatile `updatedAt`), so the '· 2h ago' clock stays accurate AND doesn't reset on edit. A dateTime (not a date) column so same-day comments can still read 'just now' / '5m ago'; `created` stays the honest day-level date shown on the record.

entries.name: finishedAt
entries.label: Finished
entries.description: The day the work was done. Left empty while it is unfinished — an empty finish date is a fact, not a gap to fill in.

entries.name: editedAt
entries.label: Edited
entries.description: Last day this was meaningfully revised. Distinct from the engine's own `updatedAt` stamp, which is rewritten on every save (and on import), so it can never carry a historical date.

entries.name: editedBy
entries.label: Edited by
entries.description: Who last meaningfully revised this — stamped on a save that actually changes a field (not on create, not on a no-op open).

entries.name: updatedAt
entries.label: Updated
entries.description: DEPRECATED — collides with the engine's reserved `updatedAt` (auto-rewritten every save), so it can't hold history; the log now shows `created` instead. Kept declared (never dropped in place) so existing rows' data is not orphaned.

entries.name: estimateMins
entries.label: Estimate (min)
entries.description: Estimated effort in minutes. Empty = unestimated (not zero).

entries.name: priority
entries.label: Priority
entries.description: Urgency axis — drives queue triage.

entries.name: importance
entries.label: Importance
entries.description: Importance axis (orthogonal to priority's urgency).

entries.name: prioLane
entries.label: Priority
entries.description: Ordered triage lane (immediate > now > next > queued > later) — drives the Priorities view and the priority filter. Separate from the pre-existing urgency (priority) and importance axes above. Unset falls back to this row's `status` (active→Now, queued→Queued, discussed→Later); a row with no status set gets no lane at all. Not auto-written (a fresh board isn't forced to assign). Labels are placeholders, renameable when the tags feature ships.

entries.name: prioRank
entries.label: Rank
entries.description: Numeric ordering within a priority lane — lower = higher rank. Equal rank means an intended batch: rows meant to complete together. Not the same as the priority/importance axes above.

entries.name: color
entries.label: Color
entries.description: Optional edge-stripe color shown on tree/lane tiles: a ramp name (blue/teal/green/purple/gray/amber/coral/red) or a #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB hex string — the SAME convention tag_types.color already uses. Typically set on a top-level project (group) row so its tasks read at a glance in any view; unset = no stripe.

entries.name: icon
entries.label: Icon
entries.description: Optional leading glyph shown on tree/lane tiles — a single emoji (e.g. 🚀). Typically set on a top-level project row alongside `color`. Unset = no glyph.

entries.name: viewMode
entries.label: View mode
entries.description: overview-0804: which detail-pane lens (type=group rows only) is currently open — Priorities/Plan/Bublie/List/Project files. Unset/"" = no lens open, the compact project OVERVIEW shows instead (stats/priorities-preview/chips/people). Written directly by ui.json's overview chips and each lens's '← Overview' button via setField — no segments-node engine hook needed (that limitation from the v1 note below no longer applies since this build stopped using the `segments` node for the group detail entirely). Default flipped from 'list' to '' so lenses open ONLY on deliberate tap, never auto-stacked. rehome-0804: 'plan' added — goals/milestones/decisions grouped by role, scoped to this project's subtree (the re-homed old dispatch Plan tab). v1 history: previously recorded intent only, never read back.

entries.name: scheduledStart
entries.label: Scheduled
entries.description: When work is planned to start.

entries.name: due
entries.label: Due
entries.description: Due / target date.

entries.name: starred
entries.label: Starred
entries.description: startags-0808: additive user star, independent of tags — toggled from the project/entry row's star affordance. Starred rows sort ahead of unstarred siblings within whatever grouping/order is already showing, and a quick ★ filter surfaces just the starred set.

entries.name: tags
entries.label: Tags
entries.description: User-editable tags — the option list is data, not a fixed schema: add/rename/recolor tag types on the Tags screen and every picker (this field, Add-filter) picks the change up live. No static options here on purpose; an empty/missing tag_types table just means no tags exist yet.

entries.name: rulesActive
entries.label: Rules active
entries.description: Marker: true when this project (type=group) carries a Rules panel — set alongside rulesVersion/rules whenever rules content is written (data/import/sync, no in-app editor in v1). Absent/false hides the Rules panel entirely.

entries.name: rulesVersion
entries.label: Version
entries.description: Short version stamp for this project's Rules panel, e.g. "v1 (2026-08-01)". Shown small above the rule lines.

entries.name: rules
entries.label: Rules
entries.description: Project rules — metadata about how work happens under this project ("respect these when working within this project"), distinct from tasks/notes. One rule per line (plain multi-line text, newline-separated). Set via data/import/sync; no in-app editor in v1.

entries.name: rulesInherited
entries.label: Rules inherited
entries.description: DERIVED (do not hand-edit): true when at least one ANCESTOR project's rules contribute to this row's effectiveRules — drives the badge on this row's explorer tile and the compact inherited-rules panel on rows with no rules of their own. SELECTIVE-INHERITANCE POLICY: the sole global root's own rules are global practice (visible at the root row itself) and are NEVER counted here or folded into effectiveRules for descendants — only a rules-carrying project BELOW the root propagates this flag/text to its subtree. This is what keeps recompute from stamping the root's rules onto every row in the tree (previously ~1,500 rows x ~573 chars). Auto-recomputed ~600ms after any board write while Dispatch is open (rulesauto-0807, debounced in app_screen.dart's `_onBoardChanged`); the Rules panel's "Recompute rules" button (hostCall recomputeRulesInheritance) still exists for an immediate/manual pass with a confirmation snackbar.

entries.name: effectiveRules
entries.label: Effective rules
entries.description: DERIVED — ancestor contains-walk concatenation, own rules last; auto-recomputed ~600ms after any board write while Dispatch is open (rulesauto-0807), or on-demand via the Rules panel action. Excludes the sole global root's rules (see rulesInherited's selective-inheritance policy) — empty when the only contributing ancestor would have been the root.

relations.name: fromId
relations.label: From
relations.description: The source node of this relationship.

relations.name: toId
relations.label: To
relations.description: The target node of this relationship.

relations.name: type
relations.label: Relationship
relations.description: How the two nodes relate. `contains` is the structural parent→child (drives the tree); the rest are free cross-links (any direction, may be mutual). Plan edges: `requires` (goal → item it needs), `completes` (milestone/task → goal it advances), `supersedes` (a decision → the earlier one it overrides). Custom types allowed.

relations.name: order
relations.label: Order
relations.description: Display order among a node's contained children.

relations.name: label
relations.label: Label
relations.description: Optional note on the edge (e.g. 'blocked on the bug fix').

tag_types.name: name
tag_types.label: Name
tag_types.description: The stored value written onto an entry's Tags field — this is the matching key, not display text. Editing it here does NOT relabel existing entries; it changes what they must match, so any entry still carrying the old value stops matching this tag. To rename what's shown without breaking existing matches, use Manage → rename (edits the Display label instead).

tag_types.name: label
tag_types.label: Display label
tag_types.description: Optional friendlier text shown in chips and pickers instead of the raw name. Leave blank to just show name.

tag_types.name: color
tag_types.label: Color
tag_types.description: Optional chip color: a ramp name (blue/teal/green/purple/gray/amber/coral/red) or a #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB hex string.
